limitations: Three wallets per measured group, six per side after pooling. The spread between two groups on identical versions reaches 0.4 s.
Worker clocks advance only at I/O. The Deriver spans are clock spans and exclude CPU after their last incoming message.
The warm-up groups are discarded from the medians; their samples are retained in the record.
The analysis script's wallet-startup checks pair Router start events to wallets across adjacent groups and are not part of this comparison.
